verdict.line: You lose the moment his E (Apprehend) lands and Hemorrhage stacks to five; you win by respecting that 535 range and forcing him to walk you down with autos instead.

brief.thesis: Darius's entire lane plan is built around one thing: landing E (Apprehend) to pull you into range, then stacking Hemorrhage to five for the enrage bonus AD. He has no gap-closer outside that pull's 535 range, so the matchup is decided by whether you let him land it. OP.GG calls this lane advantage Irelia, but the 49.1% head-to-head win rate over 1176 games says the theoretical edge only shows up if you actually play around his cooldowns instead of trading blindly.

theirWindow.what: Once pulled he chains Q (Decimate), auto, and W (Crippling Strike) to stack Hemorrhage toward five and enrage for massive bonus AD, then R (Noxian Guillotine) for true damage on top. Either trade back immediately with a pre-charged W (Defiant Dance) for the physical damage reduction, or disengage the instant he lands the hook rather than staying in the bleed.

yourWindow.what: Apprehend sits at 26/23.5/21/18.5/16s — once he's whiffed or used it to farm wave, he has no way to punish a dash. Dive in with Q (Bladesurge), land E (Flawless Duet) for the stun and Mark, then Q again off the reset for a free trade and extra passive stacks.

summoners.why: 90.4% pick at 49.4% WR — Ignite matches OP.GG's own read on this lane: it denies the sustain from his Decimate heal and secures kills before his enrage stacks let him stabilize.

playing.title: Stay outside Apprehend range
playing.detail: Hold beyond 535 range while poking with autos and Q (Bladesurge) to build Ionian Fervor stacks safely; only step in once you have the attack speed lead.

playing.title: Charge W through his commits
playing.detail: When he commits Q (Decimate) or E (Apprehend), hold and release Defiant Dance for reduced physical damage taken during the charge and a bigger hit back.

playing.title: Trade the instant E is down
playing.detail: Apprehend's cooldown runs 26-16s across ranks — once it's spent on wave or missed, dash in freely since he has no tool left to punish your Q.

playing.title: Don't dance at mid-range
playing.detail: Decimate's blade edge deals more damage and heals him off champion hits; either stay at max range or step inside his hitbox rather than sitting where the swing lands.

playing.title: Chain E into Q for the reset
playing.detail: Flawless Duet's stun and Mark refresh Bladesurge's cooldown entirely, letting you dash twice and stack passive attack speed in one trade.

playing.title: Disengage before five stacks
playing.detail: At max Hemorrhage stacks Darius enrages with massive bonus AD — bail out of the trade before the fifth stack lands instead of extending it.

playing.title: Respect Guillotine from level 6
playing.detail: Noxian Guillotine leaps 460 range for true damage and refreshes on a kill; don't sit at low HP once he's stacked bleed on you post-6.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, and win rates above are measured from real games on the current patch; the mechanical read on cooldowns, ranges, and trade timing is our own tactical analysis, not OP.GG's.
